title: Le groupement Inetum/Digitech/IT Server, fera refonte de « Madania » pour plus de 3 MDT
why_not: Gives the redesign contract's cost (3 MDT, of which over 541,000 euros) but not who finances it; its statement that Madania runs in all communal civil status services is from 2021, before the 2023-10-10 window the offices gap asks for.
